desc: Establish the interval/complement reformulation and the lemma that an optimum uses at most two nonredundant Operation-2 choices.
Derive the cost-1 and cost-2 characterizations, including disjoint complements, containment, and two interval unions.
Make containment-case reconstruction deterministic, including equal-left endpoint containment.
Perform checker-based exhaustive validation of minimum cost and coverage on small instances, including duplicates, equal endpoints, cost-3-only cases, and all edge cases.
Finalize the Python implementation with fast input/output and memory-conscious storage.
